objective: Measure, without interpolation, the raw-engine aggregate decode ceiling of the validated Qwen3.8 27B Q4_K_M TP1 source stack as parallel sequence count increases.

runtime.identity_note: This compiler differs from the 2026.0.0 TP1 headline build and therefore defines a new experimental identity. Results must not be silently pooled.

metrics.per_sequence_decode: speed_tg / pl, derived only for the same measured row
metrics.prefill: speed_pp from the same measured row

quality_boundary: llama-batched-bench feeds random token IDs and does not generate auditable model outputs. Its rows are mechanism/ceiling evidence only, never user-facing quality-qualified concurrency. A separate server endpoint run with per-request output oracles is required for promotion.
reporting_rules: Report every measured row, including regressions and failures.
Do not interpolate or extrapolate between parallel-sequence counts.
Do not call parallel sequences HTTP users or requests per second.
Do not compare speed_tg directly with the package's conventional 99-interval endpoint metric.
No throughput floor is a validity gate.
